standard_prerequisites.use: Scheme-side theory of inverse systems of coherent modules (Cohomology of Schemes, lemmas inverse-systems-abelian, inverse-systems-pullback), etale descent for coherent data as in the chapter's preceding discussion, and the groupoid-descent formal template (Groupoids, lemma-abelian).

core_obligations: Choose an affine etale presentation and import the abelian structure at the scheme level.
Reconstruct Coh(X, I) from descent data across U_0, U_1, U_2.

proof_roadmap.step: Etale descent of the scheme-side abelian category.
Flatness checked locally reduces part (3) to known exactness.

difficulty_reason: For a Noetherian algebraic space X over S with a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf I, the category Coh(X, I) of inverse systems of coherent quotients modulo I-power torsion is abelian; exactness can be checked etale locally; and for a flat map of Noetherian spaces f : X' -> X the pullback functor Coh(X, I) -> Coh(X', f^{-1}I O_{X'}) is exact. The retained proof descends all three claims along a surjective etale cover by affines U_0 -> X: the scheme-side abelianness and pullback exactness (Cohomology of Schemes, lemmas inverse-systems-abelian and inverse-systems-pullback), the descent-data description of Coh(X, I), and a formal comparison with the proof of the Groupoids chapter lemma that modules with descent data form an abelian category; part (3) reduces exactness checks to an affine cartesian etale square where flatness descends (Morphisms of Spaces, lemma-flat-local). The author marks some details omitted inside the descent formalism. Retained author proof at lines 9576-9612.
